title: A section-kept fact whose anchor window starts at a heading line is compared by the parent section, so an edit to its body reads as unchanged
goal: Found by the SP-tm4wlsve review (ST-3zlzfitj): an anchor's heading is the path of its window's first unit, and a heading line's own unit sits under its parent's path (factdiff.sections, factdiff.py:196-203; section_unchanged, :235-238; resolve, :1103). A passage whose window starts at a heading unit gets the parent's section, so an edit to the body under that heading leaves the compared section unchanged and detect, and the lookup revalidation, report the fact verbatim with signal section (pack --revalidate prints [current DATE]) for a changed passage. The comparison covers the section of every unit of the anchor's window, not only the first; the section_hash test gains a page whose fact window starts at a heading and asserts the edited body resolves modified or not-found.
